prespecification:
Prespecified 2026-11-15 ~05:55Z (00:55 EST), before any launch of round-3 workstream R (operator: Claude Opus 5.5,
claude-opus-5-5, worker for coordinator neo). Binding document: docs/research/suite/round3-prereg.md.

R: 2 more full runs per model of suite/clinical-v1@instr2 (version 2), unchanged from hosted-agents2:
  --agent claude_code_noweb-v1.0.0 --dataset suite/clinical-v1@instr2 --provider modal --model anthropic/<m>
  -s ANTHROPIC_API_KEY anthropic-api-key --concurrency 3, labels hosted-agents3a-opus, hosted-agents3b-opus,
  hosted-agents3a-sonnet, hosted-agents3b-sonnet. All four launched together.
Pooling: run 2 (hosted-agents2) is attempt 1; 3a attempt 2; 3b attempt 3. Every attempt counts.
Relaunch: once, single task, only for infrastructure failure (no agent turn recorded / sandbox never started).
Hang rule, regrade method, gap rule: identical to exp/suite-hosted-agents2/prespec.txt.
Pooled per task/model: mean and range of reward over 3 attempts; gap verdict per attempt; "gap shown in k of 3".
Budget: stop and report if this worker's API spend approaches $35.
commands: .venv-valkyrie/bin/valkyrie run start --agent claude_code_noweb-v1.0.0 --dataset suite/clinical-v1@instr2 --provider modal --model anthropic/claude-<opus|sonnet>-5-5 -s ANTHROPIC_API_KEY anthropic-api-key --concurrency 3 -l hosted-agents3<a|b>-<opus|sonnet>
pooling: Attempt R1 = hosted-agents2 (run 2, from hosted-agents2.json, rebuilt with the same builder); R2 = hosted-agents3a; R3 = hosted-agents3b. Same task version suite/clinical-v1@2.

notes.raw_values: local regrade of each carried pipeline with dist/suite-tasks-v3 tests/grade.py (hosted-agents2 method); pass/quality per case from hosted verifier lines
notes.regrade_agreement: all seven reward keys equal the hosted grade in 19 of 20 new attempts; Sonnet R3 hc18 pipeline is not deterministic (38 of 83 per-case qualities differ slightly; one case flips; local 0.880 vs hosted 0.892); hosted grade used
notes.session_fraction_used: agent process wall (metrics_total.json wall_clock_duration) / task agent timeout; queue time before the agent started is not counted
notes.api_cost: Claude Code total_cost_usd of the last result event (cumulative), list price
